items.title: Philip Morris International (PM) Stock Looks Reasonably Priced On Earnings
items.summary: Philip Morris International has delivered a powerful 5 year run, which now puts its earnings front and center for anyone trying to judge whether the current share price makes sense. With that kind of track record already on the table, the question is how much of the story is now captured in the valuation you see today. The stock has returned 181.7% over 5 years. items.title: Altria vs. Philip Morris: Higher Yield or Faster Dividend Growth for Retirees?
items.summary: Both tobacco giants beat earnings estimates, raised their dividends, and surged more than 30% this year, but they pull retirees in opposite directions when it comes to income now versus income later.
